name: Stagger Cursor Portal
description: Full-screen colored canvas with a big heading where staggered circles trail the cursor and reveal the canvas color through the white content layer using a screen blend.
contents: Full-screen colored canvas with a custom dot cursor
Stack of staggered circles that follow the pointer
Centered heading on a blended content layer
behavior: Native cursor is hidden and replaced by a small dot that tracks the pointer instantly
Circles follow the pointer with eased tweens, each delayed by the stagger offset
The content layer uses mix-blend-screen so the circles show through as a portal
Text selection color follows the canvas color
editableByProps: Canvas, content layer, cursor and circle colors
Number, sizes and trailing delay of circles

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the easing of the circles
needsCodeEdit.where: gsap.to call with ease power2.out inside handleMove

needsCodeEdit.change: Replace the heading with other content
needsCodeEdit.where: h1 inside the mix-blend-screen content layer

fixed: Root fills the viewport height. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Native cursor is hidden inside the component on all devices
Listens to pointermove on window while mounted and removes it on unmount
